ASP.NET Core loads appsettings.json first, then appsettings.<Environment>.json
on top of it. web.config sets ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production, so this file
is picked up automatically and only needs the keys that differ.
Precedence (later wins): appsettings.json < this file < environment variables
Restart or recycle the app pool after editing:

Prtg.//ApiToken: Preferred. PRTG > Setup > Account Settings > My Account > API Keys. Use a READ-ONLY key.
Prtg.//Username: Older PRTG cores only. Leave ApiToken empty if you use these.
Prtg.//AllowUntrustedCertificate: true accepts PRTG's self-signed certificate. Cleaner: import PRTG's cert into LocalMachine\Root and set this false.
